title: Mixed Event — Picture Perfect! — Episode2 A Mess Of A Meeting

meta.Episode: Episode2 — A Mess Of A Meeting
meta.Event Outline: When Kamiyama High School's very first Arts Festival is announced, Class 2-A decides to produce a film! It falls to Nene to sit in the director's chair, but will her leadership cut it?

rows.Line: A few days later
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Alright...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's begin discussing what kind of film we're going to be making for the festival...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So, I'll jump right in with the first question.
Does anyone know what kind of film they wanna make...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What kind...? You mean in terms of genre?
Like fantasy, suspense...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... Picking a specific genre should help us narrow down the themes and make it easier to decide on details.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, I say action!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Like one of those martial arts movies where the main character beats up a bunch of baddies! Those are so cool!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That would be good...
But how are we gonna do all the stunts?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: I think we'll be able to since a few people in our class are in related clubs!

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Yeah, including me, we have three from the karate club. I'm pretty sure a couple more do judo and boxing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, looks like we've got that covered...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay, then... We can jot down action as a possible candidate... Anyone else?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Oh, what about horror?!
That seems like a pretty standard choice! Plus, scaring everyone would be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: H-Horror?!

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
Yeah, I like it.
I was hoping to do a haunted house for the school festival last year, but that didn't work out. This would really scratch my itch.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wa...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait! No! Stop!
We're making this thing together, so...I feel like it'd be a waste to do something scary!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, let's go with something more fun and cheerful! That'll definitely be better!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, relax...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, we'll put a pin in horror for now. Any other ideas...?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: I know! Something centered on a family, or maybe animals! We could make it a real tearjerker!

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
How about a sci-fi film?
One with a post-apocalyptic world and aliens and stuff...!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Would cooking work?
My family runs a Chinese place, so it'd be huge if we could advertise it a little.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
S-Slow down.
Please, one at a time. I can't keep track when everyone's talking at once.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, to summarize what we've come up with...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We have action, horror, something centered on a family, something with animals, sci-fi, cooking, coming of age, suspense, historical fiction, western and...

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
Oh, don't forget comedy!
I really love manzai, so I can come up with some routines for us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay... Comedy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's nice how they've offered up so many ideas for our film...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But things might spiral out of control if this keeps up... We need to come to a decision soon.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Um, so...! We have plenty of ideas to work with now... Next, I'd like to start whittling down our options.

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay...
But they all sound really fun.

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
How do we choose just one?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... If choosing through a discussion is going to be difficult, then we can hold a vote or...

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Wait, can't we just do all of them?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All of them...? How?

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Every idea was pretty good in its own way... So, why don't we just make a film that has horror, comedy, coming of age and everything else all wrapped up together?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (What's he talking about...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (There's no way our film's going to be any good if we take all those genres and...)

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Yeah, that could end up being really fun...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: I mean, we'd be taking the best parts of each genre and stitching them together, right?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: I've never seen a sci-fi-horror-action-coming-of-age-comedy film with animals before! This could be the most genius idea ever!

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Yeah, it's gonna be an instant classic!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (A-Are they being serious right now...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Of course none of you have ever seen anything like that before... There's no way it'll feel coherent...)

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
Alright!
Let's make an awesome film and go win ourselves a prize or something!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(O-Oh no...
The ball's already rolling. I can't stop it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(No, don't give up...
Things really will spiral out of control at this rate...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to step in...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
E-Everyone...
Please try to settle down...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, can't you guys see Kusanagi's trying to say something?

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, seriously, you guys want everything crammed in together? What kind of story is that gonna be?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Shinonome...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. He has a point.
I'm with Akito on this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why don't we narrow it down to one genre and then add what we can based on your guys' ideas?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Think about it! There are plenty of action films out there that have tearjerker moments!

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: True. Everything might be a bit much...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Yeah. I guess we got a little carried away.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that!
We'll pick a single genre and then see if there's any other elements we can throw in!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How does that sound, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... G-Great!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Th-Thank goodness...
They got everyone to agree...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, as glad as I am that we won't have to make the ridiculous film everyone was just talking about...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(If this kind of thing continues...
Am I really gonna be able to do my job as the director...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Then, we'll be making an action film for the festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool! Alright, what comes next?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, umm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: First, I'll take all of the ideas you guys came up with and draft up a script...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Once that's finished, I'll have you all take a look at it... How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! I can't wait to read it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And there's the bell. Let's call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, then... Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Th-That was exhausting...
Once they get all worked up, they just keep going. I couldn't get them to settle down on my own...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nice job back there, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
Th-Thanks, you too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Crazy meeting, right?
Everybody just talked nonstop!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Haha...
Actually, I really need to thank you guys for what you did...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What did we do?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You got everyone to stop and take a step back when we couldn't pick a genre for our film.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm the director, so I should really be the one keeping everything in order...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
We're all in this together, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, if they had their way, then that would've put us all in trouble.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Exactly.
We know being the director isn't gonna be easy, so we'll do our best to give you all the support we can...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you ever feel that you need help, just ask.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, I will...
